name: Hairi
source:
A boy living in Yomi.
After the time skip, he now works as a clerk at the island’s letter bureau after handing over his [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tsujiura]tsujiura[/url] selling duties to younger children.
He secretly agrees with Olympia and the others in their efforts to change the island and takes a cooperative stance.
